title: Import finished copy as a Story's translation: papyrus stories import-translation
description:
Papyrus can machine-translate a published English Story (papyrus stories localize) and a person can correct a published translation (stories correct-translation), but there is no supported way to attach finished, separately written copy as the companion edition of an English Story. Two Beijing drafts (Spanish es-419 and Chinese zh-Hans, written by people and other agents) need it.

Build: papyrus stories import-translation --story LINEAGE --language TAG --body-file F [--front-matter-file F] --written-by NAME --reason TEXT [--dry-run]. Writes an unpublished version of the sibling lineage {primary}--{language}, paired with the published English version; provenance says who wrote it (not machine-generated); every block is owner human and pinned so a later localize run keeps it; runs the same parity, glossary and language-policy checks the localize path runs and holds error findings with a flag review request; refuses unknown or disabled languages, an unpublished English Story, a translation as the source, a body that cannot be aligned block for block, and altered links, credits or figures; writes the LocalizationRequest so stories localize --all counts it up to date; --dry-run prints the alignment and findings and writes nothing; publishing stays the ordinary publish command.

Specs: features_backend/translation-import.feature. Docs: agent-cli-guide, story-translation-procedure, multilingual-publishing plan.
